FORMULA HELP | Lecture 8 FCFE → this case FCFF
FCFE = NI + D&A − Capex − change in operating WC + net borrowing. Discount at Ke to obtain equity value directly.
FCFF = EBIT × (1−T) + D&A − Capex − change in operating WC. Discount at WACC to obtain enterprise value.
FCFF = FCFE + interest × (1−T) − net borrowing. Do not subtract interest or add borrowing in the FCFF forecast.
EBIT 120; interest 20; T 20%; D&A 10; Capex 25; change in WC 5; net borrowing 8. NI = 80; FCFE = 68; FCFF = 76.
WACC = E/(D+E) × Ke + D/(D+E) × Kd × (1−T), with market-value financing weights. The case provides 12%; estimation is not required.
Revenue(t) = Revenue(t−1) × (1+growth). EBIT = Revenue × operating margin. NOPAT = EBIT × (1−tax rate).
D&A = 1.2% × revenue; Capex = 3% × revenue; change in NWC = 15% × (Revenue(t) − Revenue(t−1)), not 15% of total revenue.
Terminal NOPAT = Revenue(5) × (1+g) × terminal margin × (1−T). Terminal FCFF = terminal NOPAT × (1−g/ROIC).
Lecture 8 uses g = equity reinvestment rate × ROE. Here g = firm reinvestment rate × ROIC; 15% × 20% = 3%. Data B13 calculates g from these supplied assumptions.
TV(5) = FCFF(6)/(WACC−g). EV = sum of FCFF(t)/(1+WACC)^t + TV(5)/(1+WACC)^5. WACC must exceed g.
(EV + cash + investments − financial debt) / diluted shares. Amounts and shares are in millions. FCFE already yields equity: do not subtract debt twice.
Use 25 × TTM EBITDA or 15 × TTM sales, then add cash/investments, subtract debt and divide by shares. Both are hypothetical teaching benchmarks, not observed peer medians.
Use RSI14 and MACD12/26 with signal9. MACD and signal formulas are in Prices columns D:H. Neither indicator establishes intrinsic value or guarantees a future return.
